title: Sidon (son of Canaan)
description: Firstborn of Canaan (Gen 10:15). Josephus (Antiquities I.6.2, Whiston): "Sidonius, who also built a city of the same name; it is called by the Greeks Sidon"

sorting_basis.note: No tier 1-4 dates this record's birth; unsorted (null).

birth.citation: Jordan, "The Chronology of the Pentateuch (Part 3)," Biblical Chronology 6:5 (May 1994), §8 "The Table of Nations", table "An Hypothetical Chronology for the Table of Nations"
birth.note: Jordan: "If we assume births every two years, and about 30 years between generations ... we can come up with an approximate series of dates" (hypothetical, not stated by Scripture). Name appears on a continuation line printed beneath this year row in the web text of the table (flattened layout); Jordan's spacing places it with that year.

open_questions: Place link is by name: OpenBible identifies the place named in later scripture (Gen.10.19, Gen.49.13), not the Gen 10 ancestor. Certainty: sidon very-high.
